subject: Pegasus security intake: IRP + SOC 2 / SIG evidence and secure transfer plan
messages:
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@pegasus-fin.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: security@pegasus-fin.com
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Pegasus intake — IRP + SOC2 / SIG evidence and transfer

Hi Neha / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. Pegasus is running a security intake for a procurement review next week (kickoff 2028-03-26). Our security team needs to validate incident readiness and control mapping before we proceed. We need the following by EOD 2028-03-22 to keep the timeline: 

- Incident Response Plan (IRP) or runbook snapshot focused on customer-facing incident handling
- SOC 2 evidence index or list of where sample artifacts live (retention windows called out)
- SIG/CAIQ answers or a mapping doc if available
- Preferred transfer mechanism (SFTP, secure Share, or enterprise Drive link); Pegasus prefers SFTP for artifacts >100MB

Please let me know: who will own the delivery, whether redacted logs are acceptable, and any constraints on retention/PII redaction. If a short call (15 min) helps, I can make time tomorrow morning.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — our procurement lead is waiting on the packet.

Best,
Sarah Kim
Director, Security Operations
Pegasus Financial
[Attachment: intake_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@pegasus-fin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Pegasus intake — IRP + SOC2 / SIG evidence and transfer

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We'll own this and can hit the 2028-03-22 deadline. Quick plan below: 

Owners and scope:
- Neha Kapoor: overall point-of-contact (will shepherd artifacts and approvals)
- Marissa Cole: IR runbook + post-incident evidence (redaction/telemetry questions)
- Karthik Iyer: logs and retention specifics (S3 snapshots, CloudTrail sampling)

Clarifying questions:
1) For logs: is a 30-day retention sample sufficient, or do you need 90 days?
2) For PII: do you require fully redacted artifacts or hashed identifiers (we usually provide hashed ids for telemetry samples)

Transfer options: we can provision a time-limited SFTP bucket with per-file checksums (recommended for bulk artifacts). If you prefer a Drive share with enterprise keys, note that large forensic exports may exceed Drive limits.

I'm attaching a preliminary evidence index (working doc) and our IR runbook snapshot. We'll update both as we confirm items. Expect a short follow-up from Marissa with items we plan to redact.

Next steps:
- Marissa will mark redaction candidates by EOD 2028-03-20
- Karthik will confirm retention windows and provide a sampling plan by 2028-03-21
- I will provision SFTP creds and upload instructions by 2028-03-21 morning PT

If that timeline works, we'll proceed and send the final package.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: soc2_evidence_index.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com>, Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@pegasus-fin.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Pegasus intake — IRP + SOC2 / SIG evidence and transfer

Sarah / team — following up with the redaction plan. Short answers first: 30-day log samples are OK for this review unless you need full-retention exports. For PII we will provide hashed identifiers and a redaction manifest.

Items I'm attaching/including in the runbook package:
- IR Runbook v2 (customer-facing incident steps, escalation matrix)
- Example timeline for a containment + postmortem (sanitized)
- Guidance on data we consider 'sensitive' and intended redaction approach

I'll flag the telemetry files that will be sanitized and include an MD5 manifest. If Pegasus needs deeper packet-level artifacts we will need an NDA/transfer agreement (let me know).

Marissa Cole
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ir_runbook_v2.pdf (application/pdf)]
